goal: A recitation of the original Mu'allaqa that Mohammed rates 9-10/10: correct grammar and letters, natural ṭawīl delivery, one connected piece; first in a measured style (al-Manṣūr level), later melodic.
rules: One round works on one section only. Anything found outside it goes into the issue log and waits for that section's turn.
Each round starts with a charter: the section, the criteria in scope, the exit targets, and a cap of 3 attempts per issue.
Every change passes the gate: it improves its own measure, breaks no regression check, and is not contradicted by Mohammed's ear. Otherwise it is reverted.
Every fixed issue becomes a regression check that runs after every recording, so it cannot come back unnoticed.
An issue that fails 3 attempts is parked with what was tried, and the round moves on.

sections.name: Grammar and text
sections.exit: All case endings and vowels match the i'rab map; endings, tanwin and inner vowels at least the reciters' level by the judge (about 90 / 85 / 95%)

sections.name: Letters
sections.exit: No letter swap in the kept takes (judge); Mohammed's flag pass finds no letter problem in a full listen

sections.name: Tajwīd rules
sections.exit: Shadda, tanwin, long vowels and qalqala pass the rebuilt checks; no ear flags on them
sections.status: in progress (shadda done by ear 30 Oct; left: tanwin dip, long vs short vowels, qalqala)

sections.name: Metre, pauses and delivery
sections.exit: No pauses inside a half; rhyme and half-ends held within the reciters' range without doubling; tone matches sentence type

sections.name: Sound and flow
sections.exit: No noise or ticks flagged; pace, loudness and pitch steady line to line; Mohammed hears one connected piece

sections.name: Art and melody
sections.exit: Decided by ear at the melodic stage

regression_checks: noise and hum: noise floor after cleanup below -55 dB
junk after the last word removed (speech end cut)
rhyme not said twice (letter judge must not hear يّ / يا at the end)
endings and tanwin no lower than the last kept round
cloud run complete: every clip kept and on disk, a track made, under 20% of clips flagged (else the run fails)
clip export not empty (else the export fails)
no doubled consonant at a shadda (letter judge must not hear the letter twice, e.g. طّط)
